name: contact_sheet
description: Tile many images into labelled contact sheets to look at: a directory, a list of paths or a tar read in place. Duplicates by sha256 (or look-alikes by average hash) are listed, not tiled twice. out_dir keeps every tile, the sheets, a manifest row per file and an index of tile to file. Resumes over calls when large. Needs Pillow (pillow_heif for HEIC).

out_dir.description: A new directory under your work directory for sheets/, tiles/, manifest.jsonl, index.jsonl and summary.json

input.description: A directory (walked, in name order) or one image file

files.description: Image paths, in the order to tile them

list_file.description: A text file with one image path per line

archive.description: A tar archive (plain or compressed) whose members are read in place, nothing unpacked

pattern.description: Case-insensitive regex a path must match (default: image extensions for input and archive; a list is taken as given unless this is set)

tile.description: Tile size in pixels, the image fitted inside it (default 160)

label.description: Label under each tile, a format with {n} {i} {name} {path} {sha8} {sha256} {w} {h} {size} {format} {mtime} (default "{n:04d} {name}")

dedup.description: sha256: exact copies tiled once (default); ahash: images that look the same too; none: every file tiled

budget_seconds.description: Work this long, then keep what is done and answer complete=false; the same call again carries on. Each call does at least one file (default 90)
